clips.title: The story
paras: In Thunder Bluff, Turak Runetotem sends young tauren druids north to study the waters. Their road leads to Nighthaven in Moonglade, where the Cenarion Circle guides their training.

After learning the bear form and its physical might, your studies turn to adaptability. Azeroth's waterways bring hazards that landbound travelers cannot face easily. Turak Runetotem watches his students and sends those devoted to nature north to learn the aquatic form.

Turak Runetotem sends you beyond Mulgore for guidance in shaping yourself for the waters. You travel to Moonglade, the sanctuary beneath Mount Hyjal, and reach Nighthaven. There, night elf mentors of the Cenarion Circle welcome tauren students. They set factional strife aside to preserve the shared teachings of Cenarius.

Dendrite Starblaze waits for you in Nighthaven, where your training begins. The night elf elder says mastery over the waters must be earned. Two trials await: one tests your endurance and composure under water, and the other calls for deep spiritual understanding of the aquatic aspect.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I have been following your progress with much delight. You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.

The time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water. For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there. He will guide you further.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Salutations, young druid; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form. It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water. You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... But it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.
You will face two trials to overcome. The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure. The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.
Stand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.
